name: 52531 · Albia, IA
findings: ZIP 52531 (Albia) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52531 (Albia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52531 (Albia) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
